resources.string: Your MOBITIK mining session is complete. Claim your reward and start your next 12-hour session.
Swaps temporarily unavailable — Liquidity pool requires funding

Each mining session runs for exactly 12 hours on MOBITIK cloud nodes without draining your device battery or data. Once the 12-hour countdown ends, mining pauses automatically until you claim your reward and start a new cycle.

• Base Reward: Earn +0.22 MBTK per completed 12-hour session.\n• Referral Bonus: Earn +0.05 MBTK for each verified Pioneer who joins with your referral code.\n• Ad-Supported Node Activation: Starting a mining session may display a short rewarded ad to support ecosystem liquidity.

• Reference Rate: 1 MBTK = 0.15 USDT (minimum swap 50 MBTK).\n• Withdrawals: Minimum $2.00 USDT with a 0.25 USDT fee on BNB Smart Chain (BEP-20), or 0% fee via instant App-to-App transfer.\n• Anti-Bot Policy: One account per person. Automated scripts or multi-accounting will freeze unverified rewards.
I have read and agree to the MOBITIK Terms of Service, 12-hour mining cycle, and reward rules.
